description: This file defines a specialized factory class for creating EventHub stream adapters used in Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically tailored for testing purposes. It includes methods for instantiation via dependency injection and configures a stream failure handler.

classes.name: TestEventHubStreamAdapterFactory
classes.description: A test-specific factory class extending EventHubAdapterFactory, providing custom creation of stream failure handlers and initialization logic for testing EventHub stream adapters.

methods.name: TestEventHubStreamAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor which initializes the factory with provided configuration options, service provider, and logger factory. Sets up a test stream failure handler.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method that retrieves configuration options and data adapter from the service provider and creates an instance of TestEventHubStreamAdapterFactory with initialized settings.
